summary.text: Bill Herbkersman is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives from District 118, in office since 2002, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Bill Herbkersman attended the University of South Carolina, Jefferson Institution in 1988.

His career experience includes work as an eco-developer and redeveloper, chair of Syndicated Investments, chief executive officer of Cycle Centers, and owner of Apex Land and Development and Marina Front Development.
Herbkersman served on the Ways and Means Committee in every session Ballotpedia lists from 2009 through 2024, including as second vice chair in 2023-2024.
For 2025-2026 he is assigned to the Labor, Commerce and Industry Committee.
